jobs.name: T-Rex
jobs.subject: A friendly cartoon Tyrannosaurus rex standing upright on two strong back legs, seen from the side, with a big head, a closed-mouth smile, two very short arms held in front of its chest and one thick tail. Very simple, only a few big shapes, smooth skin. A ground line and one small bush.

jobs.name: Triceratops
jobs.subject: A friendly cartoon Triceratops seen from the side, with three horns, a big round neck frill and four sturdy legs. Very simple, only a few big shapes, smooth skin. A ground line and a sun.

jobs.name: Langhals
jobs.subject: A friendly long-neck dinosaur seen from the side, eating leaves from a tall palm tree. Simple big shapes, smooth skin with a few big round spots on its back. A ground line.

jobs.name: Stegosaurus
jobs.subject: A friendly Stegosaurus seen from the side, with seven big rounded plates along its back and a tail with four short spikes. Simple big shapes, smooth skin. A ground line and one fern.

jobs.name: Flugsaurier
jobs.subject: A friendly cartoon Pteranodon, a flying dinosaur, flying to the right and seen from the side, with two big leathery bat-like wings, a long pointed beak, a long bony crest pointing backwards from its head, a small body and a short tail. Very simple, only a few big shapes. Two simple clouds and a sun.

jobs.name: Dino-Baby im Ei
jobs.subject: A cute baby dinosaur hatching from a big cracked egg: its head and little arms look out of the top of the shell, big round eyes. The egg has a few big round spots and sits in a simple round nest. Very simple, only a few big shapes.

jobs.name: Ankylosaurus
jobs.subject: A friendly cartoon Ankylosaurus seen from the side: a low, wide, four-legged dinosaur whose rounded back is covered by a shell of big armour plates like a turtle shell, and a long tail that ends in a big round ball. Simple big shapes. A ground line and one big leafy plant.

jobs.name: Dino-Familie
jobs.subject: A big mother long-neck dinosaur and one small baby long-neck dinosaur walk from left to right, seen from the side, the baby walks in front with a clear gap between them. Each dinosaur has one head, four legs and exactly one tail that ends behind its own body. One palm tree at the right edge, a ground line and a sun. Simple big shapes, smooth skin.

jobs.name: Bagger
jobs.subject: A big excavator seen from the side, with a cab, exactly one long bent digging arm with a bucket, and caterpillar tracks drawn as one long smooth oval band with five round wheels inside. A builder with a helmet sits in the cab. A small pile of earth. The vehicle has no face.

jobs.name: Feuerwehrauto
jobs.subject: A big fire engine seen from the side: a long truck with a driver's cab at the front, a long ladder lying on the roof, a hose reel on the side, a round light on the roof and three big wheels. A firefighter with a helmet waves from the cab window. Two simple clouds and a sun. The vehicle has no face.

jobs.name: Müllauto
jobs.subject: A refuse collection truck seen from the side: a driver's cab at the front, a big rounded container body, a loader at the back that lifts a wheelie bin, and three big wheels. A worker with a cap stands beside it. Simple big shapes. The vehicle has no face.

jobs.name: Polizeiauto
jobs.subject: A police car seen from the side driving to the right, with a light bar on the roof and two big wheels. A police officer with a cap sits in the front seat at the steering wheel, behind the front window, and waves. The back window is empty. The car front has a plain grille and a round headlamp. Very simple, only a few big shapes. A ground line and a traffic light beside the road.

jobs.name: Traktor mit Anhänger
jobs.subject: A farm tractor seen from the side standing on a straight ground line, with a huge back wheel and a small front wheel; both wheels rest on the same ground line. An exhaust pipe and a farmer in the open cab. It pulls a simple trailer with three big round hay bales, the trailer wheels also on the ground line. The tractor front has a plain grille and a round headlamp. Simple big shapes.

jobs.name: Dampflok
jobs.subject: An old steam locomotive seen from the side on a straight rail track, with a round boiler, a tall chimney with three round smoke puffs, a driver's cab with a train driver waving and three big wheels, pulling one open wagon. Simple big shapes. The locomotive has no face.

jobs.name: Rakete
jobs.subject: A tall realistic space rocket standing upright on its launch pad, with two stages, panel lines and rows of rivets, a pointed nose cone, a small round window, four fins and big engine nozzles at the bottom. Beside it a launch tower made of crossed steel girders with a ladder and a walkway arm. Big puffy steam clouds at the base, a few stars and a crescent moon in the sky. Detailed but with clear closed areas to colour.

jobs.name: Space-Shuttle
jobs.subject: A space shuttle standing upright on its launch pad, attached to the side of a big external fuel tank, with two slim booster rockets beside the tank. The shuttle has delta wings, a tail fin, cockpit windows and engine nozzles. A launch tower made of steel girders stands beside it, big puffy steam clouds at the base, a few stars in the sky. Detailed but with clear closed areas to colour.

jobs.name: Krankenwagen
jobs.subject: An ambulance van seen from the side with a light on the roof, a big simple cross symbol on its side, two big wheels and a paramedic at the wheel. Very simple, only a few big shapes. A ground line and a simple house behind. The vehicle has no face.

jobs.name: Baustein-Turm
jobs.subject: A tall tower built from big chunky plastic toy construction bricks, seen slightly from above so the top surfaces are visible. Bricks of different lengths are stacked in a staggered pattern like a brick wall, every brick has a row of short round cylinder studs on its top, clearly visible on the top brick and on the steps of the tower. A small child sits on the floor beside the tower and places one more brick on top. A rug and a toy box in the background.

jobs.name: Baustein-Haus
jobs.subject: A little house built from big toy building bricks, seen straight from the front: walls made of big rectangular bricks, a door, one square window, a triangular roof and round studs on the top bricks. A sun and a ground line. Simple big shapes.

jobs.name: Baustein-Auto
jobs.subject: A simple toy car built from big plastic building bricks with round studs on top, seen from the side, with two large round wheels. Very simple, only a few big shapes. A straight ground line under the wheels.

jobs.name: Baustein-Roboter
jobs.subject: A friendly robot built from big toy building bricks, seen from the front: a square head with two round eyes and a smile, a rectangular body, two arms and two legs, round studs on top of its head and shoulders. Very simple, only a few big shapes.

jobs.name: T-Rex fährt Bagger
jobs.subject: A happy cartoon T-Rex sits in the open cab of a big excavator and drives it, seen from the side. The excavator has exactly one digging arm with a bucket, and caterpillar tracks drawn as one long smooth oval band with four round wheels inside. Simple big shapes. A small pile of earth.

jobs.name: Triceratops bei der Feuerwehr
jobs.subject: A happy cartoon Triceratops with three horns and a big round bony neck shield, wearing a firefighter helmet, stands on the left and holds a hose that sprays an arc of water. On the right stands a fire engine seen from the side with a ladder on its roof and two big wheels. Simple big shapes.

jobs.name: Langhals als Lokführer
jobs.subject: A happy long-neck dinosaur wearing a train driver's cap rides in the open wagon of a little train, its long neck sticking high up. A small steam locomotive with a chimney and round smoke puffs pulls the wagon on a rail track, seen from the side. Simple big shapes. The locomotive has no face.

jobs.name: Dino in der Rakete
jobs.subject: A happy little dinosaur wearing a round astronaut helmet looks out of the big round window of a rocket that flies through space. Flames come out of the bottom of the rocket. Three big stars and a ringed planet. Simple big shapes.
